paragraphs: Max, who had been listening with growing interest and a clear desire to dominate the conversation, suddenly leaned forward in his expensive grey designer suit.

He adjusted his cuffs dramatically and said with a superior smile, "So, your family is also into business? That’s good to hear. If you need any help with anything — connections, introductions, even funding — just tell me."
"I have very strong connections with a lot of important people in the industry. Senators, real estate tycoons, even a few ministers... it might be really helpful in growing your little business."
He paused for dramatic effect, then asked with fake politeness dripping with condescension, "So, what is your business actually about? Imports? Exports? Some small startup, maybe?"
I kept my tone calm and deliberately understated. "Well... It’s nothing special. Not really worth mentioning right now."

Max chuckled loudly, clearly enjoying the chance to act high and mighty. He leaned back on the sofa, spreading his arms like he owned the entire hall. "It’s okay, everybody starts small. You’re still young, after all — what are you, mid-twenties? You can definitely become a millionaire like me before you reach 30 if you work hard and get the right guidance."

"My business is Lawrence and Company. We’re one of the biggest players in real estate development across Asia and Europe. We deal with luxury condominiums, five-star resorts, commercial skyscrapers... You name it. Last year alone, we closed deals worth over 450 million dollars. We just signed a massive project with the government for a new smart city development."

He took out his phone and casually flashed a few screenshots of property listings and bank statements, making sure everyone could see the huge figures. "See this? This is one of our latest projects — a 120-floor mixed-use tower in the financial district. My father is the chairman, and I’m already the Vice President of Operations."

"We have partnerships with the biggest banks and international investors. If you ever need anything — land permits, construction approvals, even private funding at low interest — I will definitely help you out, Jack. Just say the word. I like helping young entrepreneurs."

Max chuckled again, clearly satisfied that his showing-off had landed perfectly. He glanced around the group with a smug, victorious expression, as if he had just put the "new guy" in his place. "No need to feel shy. Everyone starts from the bottom. With my connections, I can fast-track a lot of things for you. What do you say?"
I nodded politely, keeping my expression neutral. "Okay... thank you, Max. I’ll keep that in mind."

Max laughed heartily, patting his own chest. "See? That’s the spirit! No shame in accepting help from someone who’s already made it. Just last month, I closed a deal with a Middle Eastern royal family for a private island resort. They paid in cash — all in one go. That’s the kind of level we operate at."
The entire group reacted differently. Alice and Selena looked impressed. Lucas nodded along politely. But Hannah and Haruna both looked visibly upset.
Haruna’s face tightened with anger, her lips pressed into a thin line as she hugged my arm even tighter, her massive soft tits squishing heavily against me through the elegant white mermaid dress.
Hannah’s expression turned sour, her hand on my waist squeezing harder in silent frustration and possessiveness.
Through the telepathic bond, Haruna’s thoughts flooded in, full of bratty jealousy and burning irritation:

[That arrogant prick! How dare he talk down to Jack like he’s some poor startup kid? Lawrence and Company? Jack could buy his entire company ten times over and still have billions left. I want Jack to destroy him completely... make him bankrupt, humiliate him in front of Ruth, and then fuck me so hard in this white dress while Max watches helplessly from the corner.]

Hannah leaned in closer to my ear, her voice low but sharp with anger. "Jack... are you really going to let this idiot talk to you like that? He’s acting like he’s some god of business when he has no idea who he’s dealing with. His ’connections’ are nothing compared to you."

Priyanka, the bold Indian beauty in her daring deep V-neck emerald green dress, noticed the tension and smirked playfully. Her full, round cleavage jiggled as she laughed softly and leaned forward even more.

"Wow, Max, you really love talking about your millions and royal connections, don’t you? Haruna’s boyfriend seems too polite to brag back. But now I’m even more curious, Jack. If your business is ’nothing special’, how did you manage to catch someone as beautiful and picky as Haruna?"

Ruth, sitting possessively beside Max in her tight black pencil dress with the high thigh slit, smiled smugly and added more fuel. "Exactly. Max is right, though — starting small is normal. Real estate is a very tough industry. Not everyone can make it big like my Max. He even has dinner meetings with cabinet ministers every month."

Haruna couldn’t hold back any longer. She glared at Ruth and said with clear irritation, "Ruth, you’re always showing off about Max and his money. Every single time we meet, it’s ’My Max took me here’, ’My Max bought me that’, ’My Max has connections with ministers’... It’s getting really old and annoying! Jack doesn’t need anyone’s help or guidance to grow his business. He’s doing perfectly fine — better than fine."

Max chuckled again, still acting superior and patting Ruth’s thigh. "No need to get defensive, Haruna. I’m just offering friendly help from someone who’s already at the top. Young guys like Jack need proper guidance sometimes. If he wants to reach my level, he’ll need the right mentor."
Hannah, still pinching my waist under the table, whispered angrily, "This guy is so full of himself. Jack, please tell me you’re going to make him regret every word that just came out of his mouth."
I simply smiled calmly and replied, "I appreciate the offer, Max. I’ll definitely keep it in mind."
Max leaned back again, looking extremely pleased with himself, completely oblivious to the fact that he had just poked a very dangerous bear.

The group fell into excited but awkward gossip, with Priyanka giving me bold, flirty looks, her deep plunging neckline on full display, while Haruna and Hannah both clung to me even more possessively, their elegant dresses brushing against my black suit, their soft breasts pressing warmly against my arms.

The luxurious gathering hall was now thick with tension, jealousy, and unspoken lust. Ruth looked annoyed but slightly nervous. Priyanka seemed highly interested. And both Haruna and Hannah were silently fuming, clearly waiting for me to put Max in his place.

chapters.title: Chapter 999: Max’s Last Show of Bravado
paragraphs: As the snacks and drinks were served — platters of elegant finger foods, fresh sushi, premium wine, and colorful cocktails — I leaned back comfortably in my seat, sipping a glass of aged whiskey while casually eating.
The previous arrogant atmosphere created by Max had completely vanished. The table had grown quieter, and the air felt thicker with unspoken tension.

I noticed Priyanka stealing glances at me from across the table. She was stunning — an Indian beauty with smooth golden-brown skin, long silky black hair cascading down her back, full lips, and a curvaceous figure that her fitted red dress struggled to contain. Her deep cleavage and wide hips made her look incredibly sensual.
Through the telepathic bond (which I had quietly extended to observe), her thoughts were crystal clear:

[Why do I feel like I’ve seen him somewhere before...? He looks so handsome... that sharp jawline, those confident eyes. And his gentleness is amazing. He looks like some big boss — powerful, rich, and dangerous in the best way. So different from these boys.]
Priyanka then turned her gaze toward Max, her expression turning cold and dismissive:
[Much better than this piece of shit, Max, who only knows how to brag and show off. He’s so pathetic compared to Jack... But Jack is already taken by Haruna. I guess I’ll just die single...]
I kept my expression neutral and took another sip of whiskey before speaking casually, "Excuse me for a moment. I have to make a quick phone call."
I stood up and walked toward the private washroom area of the upscale lounge. Once inside and locked the door, I pulled out my phone and spoke quietly but firmly:

"SERA, quickly block all the cards Max Reid has on him right now. Freeze every account linked to him and his family. Then create a complete scenario for Lawrence and Company — make them go bankrupt overnight. Plant evidence that their company has been funding terrorist organizations. Leak it to the authorities and media immediately. I want Max to become a rat in the gutter from this moment on."

SERA’s calm, feminine voice replied instantly, "Understood, Master. It will be done within the next fifteen minutes. All cards will be declined. The company’s collapse and the terrorism link will be trending by evening."
I smiled darkly. "Good. Make sure it’s thorough. I want him ruined."
"Consider it finished, Master."

I walked back out of the washroom, adjusted my black suit jacket, and returned to my seat between Haruna and Hannah. The moment I sat down, Max leaned back arrogantly in his chair, flashing a smug grin.
"Don’t worry about the bill, everyone. It’s on me tonight," he declared loudly, waving his hand like a king.
Priyanka frowned immediately. "Max... everyone can pay for their own. There is no need to show off like this."

Ruth, sitting beside Max, shot Priyanka an arrogant look, her voice dripping with superiority. "Priyanka, why are you always against Max? He’s just being kind and generous. Not everyone can afford this place, you know."
Max nodded proudly, puffing out his chest. "Yeah, exactly. Anyway, this amount of money is nothing to me. My family’s business handles millions every week. This is pocket change."
Hannah and Haruna both snorted softly at the same time, exchanging amused glances.

Lucas, sitting on the side, looked more and more like Max’s loyal little henchman, nodding along enthusiastically. Selena sighed deeply and took Priyanka’s hand, trying to calm the situation. "Fine... let him pay if he wants. It’s not worth arguing over."
Priyanka also sighed, clearly irritated, but stayed quiet. Her beautiful golden-brown eyes kept flicking back to me with obvious hidden longing, even as she tried to maintain her composure.

From the seating arrangement, it was clear the girls had naturally split into two loose groups. Selena, Priyanka, Haruna, and Hannah formed one tighter, more playful circle — laughing and whispering together — while Alice and Ruth stuck closer to each other.
They were all friends on the surface, but the underlying rivalry was palpable. Well... that’s just how friendships between girls often work.

After some time, Hannah and Haruna moved around the table, chatting animatedly with Priyanka and Selena while occasionally exchanging polite words with Alice and Ruth. Meanwhile, we boys talked about cars, superbikes, and luxury yachts — the conversation quickly turning into Max showing off again with his usual arrogance.
As the gathering began to wind down, Max stood up dramatically. "Alright, I’ll go handle the bill. As I said, it’s on me tonight."
He walked confidently toward the payment counter. A few moments later, we heard a loud commotion.

Max was yelling at the staff, his voice echoing through the upscale lounge. "How is this possible?! My card is not working! It must be your machine that’s faulty! You’re trying to blame it on me! Where is your manager? Call him here right now!"
He continued arrogantly, "Do you know who I am?! My family owns Lawrence and Company! I will make sure none of you survive in the hotel industry after this!"
Hannah and Haruna both chuckled softly, covering their mouths with their hands to hide their smug smiles. The rest of us walked over to see what was happening.
Priyanka stepped forward, trying to calm things down. "Max, why are you making such a fuss? I’ll pay. Let’s try my card to see if their machine is really at fault."

I casually took out my black card and handed it to Haruna. She understood immediately and walked over to Priyanka with a sweet smile. "Let me do it. Just think of it as a meeting gift since you all met my boyfriend for the first time today."
Priyanka accepted the reason gracefully. "Okay... then thank you, Haruna."
Haruna nodded elegantly, swiped the card, and the machine beeped cheerfully: "Payment successful."
Max’s face turned pale. "No... how is this possible? There can’t be anything wrong with my cards..."
He quickly pulled out his phone and called his father. We all clearly heard the angry yelling voice coming from the speaker:
"Shut up and come back home right now! Don’t spend any more money! We are in big trouble! I’m contacting the bank — our company accounts are all blocked. We can’t withdraw any money!"

Max stood stunned for a few seconds, staring at the hung-up phone in disbelief. When he noticed all of us looking at him, he stammered awkwardly, "I... I... there’s an emergency at home. I need to go back right now..."
He didn’t even glance at his girlfriend, Ruth. Instead, he turned and practically ran out of the lounge like a scared rat.
Ruth stood there, shocked and embarrassed, watching her boyfriend abandon her without a second thought.
